quirks: The repository's own CLAUDE.md and .claude/skills/gh-workflow still tell agents to use Closes #N; the contract's Relates to #N wins, since the issue is done only once published.
The repository squash-merges, so the pull request title is the only text semantic-release reads and its type must match the layer changed.
CI also runs make audit (composer audit) before the gates; a vulnerable dependency fails Quality Check without any gate failing.
make cs is a dry-run check; make cs-fix applies the formatting.
The devcontainer's docker-compose.yml publishes host port 8001 (MkDocs), so two worktree stacks of this repository can't run at the same time without overriding that port.
Pull requests touching .devcontainer/ also run the Devcontainer quality workflow, which is not a required check.
Merging requires a code owner's approval, resolved review threads, linear history and passing CodeQL code scanning.

main requires the branch to be up to date with main before merging (strict status checks), and a push dismisses stale approvals, so a pull request behind main is updated and validated again before it merges.
The repository has auto-merge disabled, so pr-handoff.mjs mark-ready cannot enable it: the maintainer merges by hand until it is enabled.
The devcontainer runs PHP 8.5 while CI's Quality Check runs PHP 8.4, so a local gate pass does not guarantee CI's.

stack.basis: Estimate: a single PHP 8.5 devcontainer with no services; peak is PHPStan (256M limit) or PHPUnit with Xdebug coverage, plus the devcontainer image, vendor/ and the MkDocs venv on disk.
